statement: Previous World 1 to World 4 free-to-play speedrun record was about 2 hours 40 minutes
Rules: no microtransactions, no cheating, fresh account, vanilla content with no events; timer starts with first character and stops on entering World 2
Attempt Colosseum to get a key that has a 1 in 25 chance to drop from the bronze chest
Do the Scriptus quest line during the run because it rewards lots of gems for Time Candy and also Time Candy
Time Candy is needed later in the speedrun
Two biggest Time Candy sources are the Scriptus quest line and the Picks stowaway quest line; together enough to reach Amarok
Hit at least two baskets in Hoops to get at least a 2-hour Time Candy to get past Goblins
Let second character AFK for at least 2 minutes to get the rest of the needed candy
Put talents into Carry a Big Stick, Sharpened Axe and Meat Shank while second character AFKs
Put stones into armor and weapons while the character is AFK
Amarok was nerfed so only 15 accuracy is needed to hit it 100% instead of the previous 151
Amarok gear: rce? helmet, spear, shirt and wooden katana
Good rotation and big crits are needed; don't Stone rotation for sub 11
World 1 beaten in about 11 minutes; sub 10 possible with proper RNG
Improved from 2 hours 40 minutes to under 11 minutes
